description: Buffy’s relationship with Angel deepens just as Spike and Drusilla arrive in Sunnydale, and the season turns devastating when Angel loses his soul and becomes the threat Buffy is least prepared to fight.

s02e01.description: Buffy returns from summer withdrawn and abrasive after her death at the Master’s hands, while the Anointed One’s vampires attempt to use her friends to resurrect their fallen leader.

s02e02.description: Grave robberies and missing body parts reveal that two students are assembling a bride for a reanimated young man, with Cordelia marked as the final piece.

s02e03.description: Spike and Drusilla arrive in Sunnydale, and Spike ignores vampire tradition by launching an assault on the school during parent-teacher night to test himself against Buffy.

s02e04.description: An exchange student is killed by an ancient Incan mummy who must drain life from others to remain human, and Xander unknowingly falls for her disguised form.

s02e05.description: Buffy reluctantly attends a fraternity party with Cordelia and discovers that the hosts intend to sacrifice them to a demon in exchange for wealth and privilege.

s02e06.description: A magical costume-shop spell turns Buffy, Xander and Willow into the characters they dressed as for Halloween, leaving Sunnydale exposed while Spike takes advantage of the chaos.

s02e07.description: Buffy’s old friend Ford arrives with a terminal illness and a desperate plan to trade a group of vampire enthusiasts to Spike in exchange for becoming immortal.

s02e08.description: A demon tied to Giles’s reckless youth returns and begins possessing people around him, forcing Giles to reveal a past that puts Jenny Calendar directly in danger.

s02e09.description: Career week is interrupted when Spike hires assassins to kill Buffy while he searches for the ritual needed to restore Drusilla, and another Slayer unexpectedly appears in Sunnydale.

s02e10.description: Buffy and Kendra reluctantly join forces to rescue Angel, whose blood is needed for Spike’s ritual to heal Drusilla, while the hired assassins continue closing in.

s02e11.description: Buffy distrusts Joyce’s charming new boyfriend Ted, and after a violent confrontation she discovers that his wholesome exterior conceals something decidedly nonhuman.

s02e12.description: A school assignment requiring students to care for eggs becomes a parasitic infestation when the creatures inside begin controlling their hosts and serving a buried monster.

s02e13.description: On Buffy’s birthday, Drusilla and Spike assemble the Judge while Buffy and Angel finally consummate their relationship, unknowingly triggering the curse attached to Angel’s soul.

s02e14.description: Angel awakens without his soul and joins Spike and Drusilla, leaving Buffy devastated as she must stop the Judge and accept that the man she loved has become Angelus.

s02e15.description: A werewolf hunter comes to Sunnydale just as the gang discovers the creature is someone they know, and Oz learns the truth about what happens to him during the full moon.

s02e16.description: After Cordelia breaks up with him, Xander asks Amy for a love spell; it backfires spectacularly and makes nearly every woman in Sunnydale dangerously obsessed with him.

s02e17.description: Angelus escalates his campaign of psychological cruelty against Buffy and her friends, while Jenny works secretly to restore his soul and pays a terrible price when he discovers her plan.

s02e18.description: Hospitalized with a severe fever, Buffy becomes able to see a normally invisible demon that preys on sick children and must fight it despite her own weakened condition.

s02e19.description: A pair of doomed lovers from Sunnydale High’s past repeatedly possess students and staff to reenact their murder-suicide, with Buffy and Angelus drawn into the final repetition.

s02e20.description: Members of the championship swim team begin turning into aquatic monsters, prompting Xander to go undercover and Buffy to investigate the coach’s disturbing training program.

s02e21.description: Angelus prepares to awaken Acathla and drag the world into hell, while Willow discovers a possible way to restore his soul and Buffy learns more about how Angel first became a vampire.

s02e22.description: Buffy is expelled, exposed as the Slayer to her mother and forced into a final duel with Angelus as Willow’s soul-restoration spell and Acathla’s awakening converge at the worst possible moment.
